quotes.author: Alexa
quotes.text: This was my first solo trip and I am now hooked on solo travel! EF Go Ahead Tour was everything I was hoping for; structured, secure, and lots of free time! I will definitely book another go ahead tour in the near future. I can’t wait to see many more greek islands! All our hotels and activities were outstanding and I really did not want to take my flight home. I met some amazing people whom I hope to travel with again. Jason was also a fantastic tour guide who was a lot of fun and very helpful. Highly recommend this tour to anyone seeking adventure, good food, beautiful sites and relaxing beaches!!!

quotes.author: Alan
quotes.text: Stefania, our Tour Director, was the best part of the tour. She is so kind, caring, and thoughtful. She took us to Venice, Florence, Rome. Then to Sorrento for Pompeii and Capri. The boutique hotels were very nice. The Italian people are so friendly. Fellow travelers and tourist were accommodating. The Ancient sites and history is breathtaking. Stefania provided so much history and her local guides were great. I recommend the EFGO Ahead Italy tour - especially if it is with Stefania ❤️

quotes.author: Sokheng
quotes.text: Our EF Tour was absolutely amazing and gave us memories that my sons and I will cherish forever. From London to Paris to Italy, every destination was filled with beautiful architecture, incredible art, history, culture, and unforgettable experiences. I loved how everything was organized, which allowed us to simply enjoy the journey and make the most of every moment. This was truly a trip of a lifetime, and I can’t wait to travel with EF again! ❤️✈️🌍

quotes.author: Theresa
quotes.text: What an amazing experience..This was my first trip internationally and my first solo trip..My group of fellow travelers were amazing and I hope they will become lifetime friends..There were so many interesting things to see in each of the areas we visited..I would definitely recommend this..Our tour director Annamaria just made our trip..Her background in art history certainly gave us a unique and inspiring perspective into everything.

quotes.author: Paulina
quotes.text: Our tour to Istanbul was great! Our tour director Mehmet was very nice and he provided us with a great tour. He was very informative, helpful, patient. He gave great suggestions such as where to eat, activities etc. While we were on the bus he told us history about Turkey. Our hotels that were picked were all nice and food was good. I have no complaints. I met some nice people from all over the US and I can’t wait to do it again.

quotes.author: Anonymous
quotes.text: If you are thinking to book this tour? Do It. Our tour guide Mehmet was AMAZING. He explained everything about what we are going to do every day. He was very well organized. He knows the history of his country and he love his country. This tour was my first solo trip and I can tell you thatI have so much fun and the group was a very good people to meet and have fun.
